articles.title: Stocks give back gains as Anthropic dips below IPO price
articles.summary: Hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by Barron's markets reporter Jacob Sonenshine, tackle the top stories of the day. Including futures sliding after Monday's biggest rally since April 2025, Anthropic briefly trading below its $83 IPO price, a Wall Street Journal report that the U.S. is preparing new tariffs on China and dozens of other countries, and whether Jensen Huang's return leaves Nvidia owing a favor to the White House. The team is joined by Seaport Research Partners senior analyst Jay Goldberg and Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin to discuss what Jensen Huang needs to tell shareholders, the competitive threat from Broadcom and AMD, and whether Nvidia's financing of neoclouds is a wobbly foundation. The show closes on Strategy trading below the value of its Bitcoin, Sanofi's $41 billion deal for Insmed, and a strong day for retail earnings from Best Buy, Dollar Tree, Dick's, Abercrombie, and Kohl's.
